title: Lab
not_in: You are not in this lab now.
role_admin_help: Invites and removes people, and changes the lab settings.
role_member_help: Reads and adds to the lab space.

set_kinds: Kinds of source that the lab can use
matching_on: Anagram suggests people outside the lab from the lab space
models_local: Only the model on each computer
set_external: Text sent to an external model
